assumptions.statement: site_boundary.geojson and key_areas.geojson are derived from the repository-maintained provisional rough polygons (agent_inferred_from_public_data, official_boundary=false, boundary_precision=provisional_rough). They are used only for generation, visualization, and intake self-check.
assumptions.impact: All area-based metrics must be recalculated when official polygons are supplied; provisional values must not be used as official redline, approval basis, or precise-area basis.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls (floor area ratio, building height, density, green ratio, setbacks), road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission for provided design layers; statutory controls remain pending professional confirmation (metric floor_area_ratio is unknown).

assumptions.statement: Rail alignment, station footprints, road redlines, and traffic cross-sections are concept-level only; transit_connection lines near Dazhongsi station are schematic and must not be read as engineering proposals.
assumptions.impact: Station-area integration is described as a concept direction for professional teams to deepen.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are schematic placeholders generated deterministically inside land-use zones; they express scale and typology, not real buildings, ownership, or approved construction scale.
assumptions.impact: Building footprint area is a design-proposal value; parcel-level retain/renovate/demolish conclusions require survey and ownership data.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenario cards, pilgrimage landmarks, annual events, developer community operations, and policy suggestions are conceptual suggestions or reference schemes for professional teams, not approved government actions or confirmed implementation.
assumptions.impact: No scenario, event, policy, investment, or operation item is claimed as confirmed.

assumptions.statement: All AI scenarios comply with data minimization, public-source-only, explainability, and human review principles; no personal privacy data or non-public data is used or required.
assumptions.impact: Personas are conceptual profiles, not personal data; scenario operations require separate authorization before deployment.
